attempts.summary: Deployed an inventory application on node1 (CentOS Stream 10) served by httpd on TCP port 8181, with SELinux kept in Enforcing mode throughout. Configured the required SELinux port context (http_port_t for tcp/8181) via semanage, restored file contexts on the docroot, opened the firewalld port, and verified HTTP 200 responses with no AVC denials. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a healthy pre-restart baseline (boot_id, SELinux enforcing, httpd active, HTTP 200 on 8181), issued a native systemd reboot, polled until exec access returned, proved the boot_id changed, and confirmed full post-restart recovery of SELinux enforcing mode, httpd service, port 8181 listener, SELinux port policy, firewall rule, and inventory content.
